posts.content_md:
My dad gave Susan and I a porcelain angel for our first Christmas together and when unpacking the ornaments to decorate the tree I realized she'd make a good holography subject.

So I decided to shoot her (figuratively) and give the hologram to my dad for Christmas.

![Image](http://www.dragonseye.com/gallery/d/5512-4/Angel1.jpg)![Image](http://www.dragonseye.com/gallery/d/5515-4/Angel2.jpg)
